footnotes.fn_0543611d: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic is a Government estimate. UNHCR is assisting 18,300 Iraqis at the end of 2015. Figure includes 33,200 Iraqi refugees registered with UNHCR in Jordan. The Government estimates the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_3de0211d: With regards to refugee statistics, official statistics on the size of the refugee population are not available. UNHCR refugee population estimates are based on the cumulative number of recognized asylum-seekers over the past 10 years, plus the reported number of beneficiaries of Temporary Protection in the country by end-2025.
footnotes.fn_48ea83de: The refugee population in Jordan includes 8,900 Iraqis registered with UNHCR.The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_5865f98d: With regards to stateless statistics, the figures include: (a) the number of stateless asylum seekers at end-year reported by the Finnish authorities; (b) the number of stateless refugees at year-end based on UNHCR's estimation of refugees in Finland (recognized asylum-seekers over that past 10-years); and (c) the number of non-displaced stateless persons (those with other non-protection related types of permits) based on data from Statistics Finland corresponding to the resident population recorded as "Stateless" as of 31 December 2023 (no available data for end-2024 yet), deducting the estimated number of stateless refugees.
footnotes.fn_7c635ee6: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic was a Government estimate. UNHCR has registered and is assisting 16,300 Iraqis at the end of 2017. The refugee population in Jordan includes 34,000 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_7d4c1fc7: With regards to refugee statistics, official statistics on the size of the refugee population are not available. UNHCR refugee population estimates are based on the cumulative number of recognized asylum-seekers over the past 10 years, plus the reported number of beneficiaries of Temporary Protection in the country by end-2024.
footnotes.fn_8fd4b726: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic was a Government estimate. UNHCR has registered and is assisting 15,700 Iraqis at the end of 2018. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_a933bd02: The refugee population in Jordan includes 34,350 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_a9d2bd4e: The decrease in the stateless population in Finland between 2022 and 2023 is due to de-duplication of figures reported in previous years.
footnotes.fn_c2269fb9: The stateless statistics include: (a) the number of stateless asylum seekers by end-year reported by the Finnish authorities; (b) the number of stateless refugees by end-year based on UNHCR's estimation of refugees in Finland (recognized asylum-seekers over that past 10-years) as well as those with temporary protection status by end-year; and (c) the number of non-displaced stateless persons (those with other non-protection related types of permits) based on data from Statistics Finland corresponding to the resident population recorded as "Stateless" as of 1 January 2026, deducting the estimated number of stateless refugees.
footnotes.fn_e0a18add: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic is a Government estimate. UNHCR is assisting 16,900 Iraqis at the end of 2015. Figure includes 33,100 Iraqi refugees registered with UNHCR in Jordan. The Government estimates the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_e5af6ba7: The refugee population in Jordan includes 31,000 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
